note: Y9 Spring Block 4 Constructions and congruence: one set of templates per small step of the White Rose Maths scheme of learning.

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S1 Draw and measure angles
templates.text: A protractor shows [[a]]° on the inside scale for an angle. What does the outside scale show?

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S1 Draw and measure angles
templates.text: To draw a reflex angle of [[a]]°, which angle could you measure with a protractor and how?
templates.answer: Draw [[360 - a]]° and use the other side: 360 − [[a]] = [[360 - a]]°

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S1 Draw and measure angles
templates.text: Ben measures an angle as [[a]]° but it is obtuse. Ali says the angle is [[180 - a]]°. Who is right and why?
templates.answer: [[a > 90|if:Ben is right/Ali is right]]: an obtuse angle is more than 90°, so the correct reading is the larger of [[a]]° and [[180 - a]]°

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S1 Draw and measure angles
templates.text: Angles in a triangle are measured as [[a]]°, [[b]]° and [[c]]°. Is the measurement accurate? What is the error? (2 marks)
templates.answer: Angles should add to 180°; [[a]] + [[b]] + [[c]] = [[a + b + c]]°, so the total is [[a + b + c - 180 > 0|if:too big/too small]] by [[abs(a + b + c - 180)]]°

templates.subtopic: Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S2 Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.text: A triangle has $AB$ = [[l]] cm, angle $A$ = [[x]]° and angle $B$ = [[y]]°. Work out angle $C$.

templates.subtopic: Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S2 Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.text: Which case is used to draw a triangle with $AB$ = [[l]] cm, $AC$ = [[m]] cm and angle $A$ = [[x]]°: SSS, SAS or ASA?
templates.answer: SAS (two sides and the included angle)

templates.subtopic: Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S2 Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.text: Triangle $ABC$ has $AB$ = [[l]] cm, angle $A$ = [[x]]° and angle $B$ = [[y]]°. Is there only one possible triangle? Find angle $C$.
templates.answer: Yes (ASA): angle $C$ = [[180 - x - y]]°

templates.subtopic: Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S2 Accurately draw triangles using ASA and SAS
templates.text: Triangle $PQR$ has $PQ$ = [[l]] cm, angle $P$ = [[x]]° and $PR$ = [[m]] cm. (a) Which case is this? (b) What do you draw first? (c) Is the triangle fixed? (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) SAS  (b) the angle [[x]]° at $P$ with $PQ$ = [[l]] cm  (c) yes, the triangle is fixed

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S3 Accurately draw triangles using SSS
templates.text: Can a triangle have sides [[a]] cm, [[b]] cm and [[c]] cm?
templates.answer: [[a + b > c && a + c > b && b + c > a|if:Yes/No]]

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S3 Accurately draw triangles using SSS
templates.text: Two sides of a triangle are [[a]] cm and [[b]] cm. Between what values must the third side lie?
templates.answer: More than [[abs(a - b)]] cm and less than [[a + b]] cm

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S3 Accurately draw triangles using SSS
templates.text: To draw a triangle with sides [[a]] cm, [[b]] cm and [[c]] cm you draw the [[a]] cm side then use compasses. What two compass radii do you use?
templates.answer: [[b]] cm from one end and [[c]] cm from the other end, so the arcs cross at the third vertex

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S3 Accurately draw triangles using SSS
templates.text: A triangle has sides [[a]] cm, [[b]] cm and $x$ cm where $x$ is a whole number. List the possible values of $x$. (3 marks)
templates.answer: $[[abs(a - b) + 1]]$ to $[[a + b - 1]]$ (that is [[a + b - 1 - abs(a - b)]] values)

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S4 Construct a perpendicular bisector
templates.text: $AB$ is [[l]] cm long. When you construct its perpendicular bisector, how far is the midpoint from $A$?

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S4 Construct a perpendicular bisector
templates.text: $P$ is on the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ and $PA$ = [[p]] cm. How long is $PB$? Why?
templates.answer: [[p]] cm: every point on the perpendicular bisector is the same distance from $A$ and $B$

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S4 Construct a perpendicular bisector
templates.text: When constructing the perpendicular bisector of a line [[l]] cm long, Mia sets her compasses to [[r]] cm. Will it work? Explain.
templates.answer: [[r * 2 > l|if:Yes/No]]: the radius must be more than half the line, [[l / 2]] cm, for the arcs to cross

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S4 Construct a perpendicular bisector
templates.text: $AB$ is [[6 * k]] cm. $P$ is on the perpendicular bisector of $AB$ with $PA$ = [[5 * k]] cm. How far is $P$ from the line $AB$? (3 marks)
templates.answer: [[4 * k]] cm (by Pythagoras: [[5 * k]]² − [[3 * k]]² = [[4 * k]]²)

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S5 Construct an angle bisector
templates.text: An angle of [[a]]° is bisected. How big is each half?

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S5 Construct an angle bisector
templates.text: The bisector of angle $ABC$ makes an angle of [[a]]° with $BA$. How big is angle $ABC$?

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S5 Construct an angle bisector
templates.text: You construct a 60° angle and bisect it [[n]] times. What angle do you get?

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S5 Construct an angle bisector
templates.text: Describe how to construct an angle of [[k]]° using only compasses and a straight edge, starting from a 60° angle. (3 marks)
templates.answer: [[k == 30|if:Bisect the 60° angle/]][[k == 45|if:Construct a 90° angle then bisect it/]][[k == 15|if:Bisect the 60° angle to make 30° then bisect again/]][[k == 120|if:Construct two 60° angles next to each other/]]

templates.subtopic: Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S6 Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.text: Point $P$ is [[h]] cm from a line $L$ measured along the perpendicular. What is the shortest distance from $P$ to $L$?
templates.answer: [[h]] cm: the perpendicular distance is the shortest

templates.subtopic: Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S6 Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.text: A triangle has a base of [[b]] cm and a perpendicular height of [[h]] cm. Work out its area.
templates.answer: [[b * h / 2]] cm²

templates.subtopic: Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S6 Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.text: $P$ is [[4 * k]] cm from a line, measured along the perpendicular. $Q$ is on the line [[3 * k]] cm along from the foot of that perpendicular. Work out $PQ$.

templates.subtopic: Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S6 Construct a perpendicular from or to a point
templates.text: A triangle has a base of [[b]] cm and area [[A]] cm². (a) Work out its perpendicular height. (b) A point is constructed [[h]] cm above the base on a perpendicular through its midpoint. Is the area bigger or smaller than $A$? Explain. (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) [[2 * A / b]] cm  (b) [[h > 2 * A / b|if:bigger/smaller]]: area = ½ × [[b]] × [[h]] = [[b * h / 2]] cm²

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S7 Accurately draw more complex polygons
templates.text: To construct a regular polygon with [[n]] sides inside a circle, what angle at the centre does each side make?

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S7 Accurately draw more complex polygons
templates.text: A regular [[n]]-sided polygon is drawn. What is the size of each interior angle?

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S7 Accurately draw more complex polygons
templates.text: To draw a regular hexagon of side [[s]] cm using compasses, what radius do you set and why?
templates.answer: [[s]] cm: the radius equals the side length because the triangles at the centre are equilateral

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S7 Accurately draw more complex polygons
templates.text: A regular octagon is constructed inside a circle of radius [[r]] cm. (a) What angle at the centre does each side make? (b) What is the interior angle? (c) Is the side length equal to [[r]] cm? Explain. (3 marks)
templates.answer: (a) 45°  (b) 135°  (c) No: the triangle at the centre has a 45° angle, so it is not equilateral: the side is about [[0.765 * r|dp:1]] cm, shorter than the radius

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S8 Identify congruent figures
templates.text: Triangle $ABC$ has sides [[a]] cm, [[b]] cm and [[c]] cm. Triangle $DEF$ has sides [[b]] cm, [[c]] cm and [[a]] cm. Are they congruent?
templates.answer: Yes: all three sides are equal (SSS)

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S8 Identify congruent figures
templates.text: Two rectangles measure [[a]] cm by [[b]] cm and [[b]] cm by [[a]] cm. Are they congruent? One is rotated.
templates.answer: Yes: they have the same side lengths, only the orientation is different

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S8 Identify congruent figures
templates.text: Triangle $ABC$ has angles [[x]]°, [[y]]° and [[180 - x - y]]°. Triangle $DEF$ has the same angles but its sides are twice as long. Are they congruent? Explain.
templates.answer: No: they are the same shape but different sizes (similar, not congruent)

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S8 Identify congruent figures
templates.text: A square has side [[s]] cm. A second square has an area of [[s * s]] cm². Are the squares congruent? What if its perimeter is [[4 * s]] cm instead? (2 marks)
templates.answer: Yes: area [[s * s]] cm² means side [[s]] cm; perimeter [[4 * s]] cm also means side [[s]] cm, so congruent in both cases

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S9 Congruent triangles
templates.text: Two triangles have [[k == 0|if:three pairs of equal sides/]][[k == 1|if:two sides and the angle between them/]][[k == 2|if:two angles and a corresponding side/]][[k == 3|if:a right angle, the hypotenuse and one other side/]][[k == 4|if:three pairs of equal angles/]] equal. What does this prove?
templates.answer: [[k == 0|if:SSS/]][[k == 1|if:SAS/]][[k == 2|if:ASA/]][[k == 3|if:RHS/]][[k == 4|if:not enough to prove congruence/]]

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S9 Congruent triangles
templates.text: Triangles $ABC$ and $DEF$ are congruent with $AB$ = $DE$ = [[a]] cm and angle $A$ = angle $D$ = [[x]]°. Angle $B$ = [[y]]°. What is angle $E$ and why?
templates.answer: [[y]]°: corresponding angles in congruent triangles are equal

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S9 Congruent triangles
templates.text: In triangles $ABC$ and $ADC$, $AB$ = $AD$ = [[p]] cm, $BC$ = $DC$ = [[q]] cm and $AC$ is common. Prove they are congruent and say what angle is equal to angle $B$.
templates.answer: SSS: $AB = AD$, $BC = DC$, $AC = AC$. So the triangles are congruent and angle $B$ = angle $D$

templates.source: Y9 Spring B4 Constructions and congruence · S9 Congruent triangles
templates.text: $ABCD$ is a rectangle with $AB$ = [[3 * k]] cm and $AD$ = [[4 * k]] cm. Prove that triangles $ABD$ and $CDB$ are congruent, and find the length of $BD$. (4 marks)
templates.answer: $AB = CD$, $AD = CB$ (opposite sides), $BD$ common: SSS. $BD$ = [[5 * k]] cm by Pythagoras
